description: This PHP source file defines the `Popup_Picker` class used for generating and processing popup selections within the SuiteCRM CampaignLog module. It includes methods for building query clauses and rendering HTML popups for selecting campaign logs, with multi-select support and form handling.

classes.name: Popup_Picker
classes.description: Handles the generation and processing of popup selection interfaces for CampaignLog entries within SuiteCRM, supporting multi-select and search filtering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the Popup_Picker class. Currently empty.

methods.name: _get_where_clause
methods.description: Builds and returns the SQL WHERE clause based on request parameters, primarily filtering by activity_type='targeted'.

methods.name: process_page
methods.description: Generates the HTML content for the popup page, including search form, listing entries with list view, and action buttons. Supports multi-select mode.
